core.lists.description-lists-of-options: Lists of options of the theatre's own, for forms and records to choose from. The lists a module uses, such as its reasons for a refund, are on that module's page under Modules, on its Lists tab.
core.lists.title-no-lists-of: No lists of your own yet
core.lists.description-make-one-when: Make one when a form or a record needs its own set of options to choose from.
core.lists.description-a-list-of: A list of options of the theatre's own, for forms and records to choose from.
core.lists.description-the-choices-this: The choices this module offers in its pickers, such as reasons. Open a list to add, rename, reorder or retire its terms.
core.lists.description-this-module-has: This module has no lists of its own.
core.vocabulary-terms.description-terms-: Terms sit under headings, one level deep. A heading with terms under it cannot be removed: move them first.
core.vocabulary-terms.heading: Heading
core.vocabulary-terms.label: Label
core.vocabulary-terms.choose-heading: Choose the heading it goes under.
core.vocabulary-terms.remove-consequence: It has no terms, so nothing else changes.
core.vocabulary-terms.delete-consequence: No record uses it, so nothing else changes. This cannot be undone.
core.vocabulary-terms.order-help: Drag a row by its handle to reorder. From the keyboard, focus the handle and press the up or down arrow.
core.vocabulary-terms.terms-help-locked: Renaming a term renames it on every record. This list is locked: you can rename and reorder its terms, but not add, retire or delete them.
core.vocabulary-terms.terms-help: Renaming a term renames it on every record. A term's label should never be a person's name.
core.vocabulary-terms.no-terms: No terms yet. Add the first one above; it then shows wherever this list is offered.
core.vocabulary-terms.none-under-heading: No terms under this heading yet.
core.vocabulary-terms.retired-help: Retired terms are left out of every picker and still show on the records that use them.
core.lists.name: Name
